summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and then invokes it (execFileSync) to run a bundled 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js. setup.mjs itself uses hex-obfuscated identifiers (_0xNNNN pattern). math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW / n7gIxM constant table) prefixed with a @bun/@bun-cjs header, opaque to Node-based inspection. The package presents itself as an ESLint configuration and index.js is a three-line eslint export (require('./plugins/formatjs')), which has no need for a separate JS runtime or a large binary payload; the entire install-time surface is unrelated to the declared purpose. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled obfuscated blob is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and causes attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host during npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
